Boiling Point: 3.4 (Air = 1 at the boiling point of phosphoric acid)
Solubility: Soluble in water, alcohol; soluble in 8 volumes of 3:1 ether:alcohol mixture
Drug Indication: Phosphoric acid is used in dentistry and orthodontics as an etching solution, to clean and roughen the surfaces of teeth where dental appliances or fillings will be placed.
